items.sentence: Complainants began their employment with the Agency in [MASK] at the Pay Band IV level.

Starting on [MASK], Complainants each filed formal EEO complaints alleging that the Agency subjected them to discrimination and harassment on the bases of race (Native American), national origin (Native American), and sex, 3 and in reprisal for prior protected EEO activity, when: 1.
[MASK] 2 claimed that the Agency failed to account for changes in her prior salary or teaching wages and only offered a salary that was commensurate with her current tribal salary. b.

In or around [MASK], the Executive Director, Public Safety Advocacy Directorate (“Executive Director”) directed Complainants’ supervisor (“Supervisor 1”) to conduct a review to address wage and pay band disparities, but the Executive Director and a Senior Director took no action after the review was completed and failed to acknowledge that it occurred. d.

In a [MASK] telephone conversation, the Senior Director claimed that he was unaware of the above-referenced review, but Complainants later learned from Supervisor 1 that the Senior Director was “very well aware” of it. e.
